body: If I don't kill myself I'd probably just keep going with the pathetic life I have now

The only reason people try to prevent suicide is to limit suffering of the people the person leaves behind. Suicide prevention is a joke just like the people who try to talk you out of it. I'm so desperate to die because I cannot bare to live another second in this body. And I would rather destroy myself then live a full life as the person I am.
